# rocket.glb

A three-stage launcher with its escape tower, made from NASA's Saturn V model with the markings taken out.

- Source: NASA 3D Resources, "Saturn V", https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/saturn-v/
  (file `Saturn V.glb`, 927,212 B, dated 14 April 2025; also https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources)
- Credit: NASA/Michael D. Carbajal
- Terms: NASA's 3D Resources are offered free and without copyright. The NASA insignia and names may not be used to
  suggest NASA endorses anything; this copy carries none of them.

- Changed: `v2/scripts/vendor_model.py` took out its four textures (the "USA" lettering and the flags), painted the
  parts they covered plain white (0.94 grey), and repacked the geometry. Shape, the black and white roll pattern and
  the parts' names are as NASA made them. SHA-256 of this file: 286071d42904527d95a7c212388557b6277cf9f735f69fe4c39b3320dbe330cf (831500 B)
